name: sift
description: Typed judgement calls for Claude Code: verbatim compaction, tool output pruning, repo watching, and issue/PR/commit/release/rules grading, backed by TypeSafe Jev or the session's small model.

backend.title: Judge backend
backend.description: auto uses Jev when a key is present and the session's small model otherwise. off disables every judged feature and leaves only mechanical checks.

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: Jev key. Leave unset to read TYPESAFE_API_KEY from the environment.

jevModel.title: Jev model
jevModel.description: TypeSafe model name sent with every Jev request.

jevBaseUrl.title: Jev endpoint
jevBaseUrl.description: System One endpoint. Change it only for a proxy or a compatible local server.

fallbackModel.title: Model backend alias
fallbackModel.description: Model used by the model backend, an alias such as haiku or a full id.

shadow.title: Shadow mode
shadow.description: Every module logs what it would have done and does nothing. Use it to calibrate thresholds before trusting them.

compact.title: Context compaction
compact.description: Replace the compaction summary with the transcript minus the tool calls and results the judge marks stale. Text is never touched.

compactKeepThreshold.title: Compaction keep threshold
compactKeepThreshold.description: Minimum probability that a tool call or its result is still needed. Below it the call is dropped or the result truncated.

compactPinRecent.title: Compaction pinned recent messages
compactPinRecent.description: Newest messages never touched by compaction.

compactMinReduction.title: Compaction minimum reduction ratio
compactMinReduction.description: Compaction falls back to the built-in summary when the estimated reduction is below this ratio.

compactTruncateHead.title: Compaction truncated result head chars
compactTruncateHead.description: Characters of a truncated tool result kept before the omission note.

compactAtPercent.title: Compact at context percent
compactAtPercent.description: Request compaction after a turn once the context passes this fill. 0 leaves compaction to the engine's own trigger.

prune.title: Tool output pruning
prune.description: Score long tool outputs before the model reads them and drop chunks the judge marks unneeded. Full output is archived for recovery.

pruneFloorTokens.title: Prune floor (estimated tokens)
pruneFloorTokens.description: Tool outputs under this estimated size pass through untouched.

pruneKeepThreshold.title: Prune keep threshold
pruneKeepThreshold.description: Minimum probability that a chunk is needed. Below it the chunk is replaced by an omission note.

pruneTools.title: Pruned tools
pruneTools.description: Comma separated tool names whose output is pruned. Bash and Read are supported.

watch.title: Repo watch
watch.description: Poll a GitHub repo for issues, PRs, comments, edits, labels and CI, and deliver actionable events as prompts.

watchRepo.title: Watched repo
watchRepo.description: owner/name. Empty watches the session's own repo.

watchMinInterval.title: Watch poll interval when active (s)
watchMinInterval.description: Seconds between polls while the repo is changing.

watchMaxInterval.title: Watch poll interval when idle (s)
watchMaxInterval.description: Seconds between polls once the repo is idle. Idle polls are conditional requests and cost no API quota.

watchDelivery.title: Watch delivery
watchDelivery.description: prompt submits each actionable event as a user turn. log only writes transcript lines.

watchIgnoreSelf.title: Watch ignores own writes
watchIgnoreSelf.description: Events authored by the gh login this session runs as are deferred, not delivered.

watchIgnoreBots.title: Watch ignores bot accounts
watchIgnoreBots.description: Events authored by bot accounts are dropped.

watchCi.title: Watch CI events
watchCi.description: failures delivers failed runs on protected branches, all delivers every completed run, none delivers no CI.

watchTriage.title: Watch triage with the judge
watchTriage.description: Run the triage pack on issue and PR events. Off delivers everything the rules do not defer.

watchDeferMaxAgeHours.title: Deferred event max age (h)
watchDeferMaxAgeHours.description: A deferred event older than this is delivered on its own so nothing waits forever.

grade.title: Grading tools
grade.description: Register sift_grade (packs: issue, pr, commit, release, rules) and sift_judge (raw typed questions) as tools.

gate.title: Command gate
gate.description: Judge Bash, Write and Edit calls against safety propositions before they run. Denies on a violated band.

gateFailClosed.title: Gate denies on unclear
gateFailClosed.description: Deny a call when a fail-severity proposition lands in the unclear band. Off allows it.

classify.title: Answer engine classifications
classify.description: Serve the engine's own model.classify calls from the judge backend.

route.title: Effort routing
route.description: Score each prompt and lower the request effort for routine turns. Experimental.

routeMinEffort.title: Route floor
routeMinEffort.description: Lowest effort the router may choose.

routeMaxEffort.title: Route ceiling
routeMaxEffort.description: Highest effort the router may choose.
